pages.title: Burning Worlds
pages.text: It is possible to stabilize a dangerous Age, but the price is total erasure. You must feed the unstable world the life of another, calmer one. Only $(item)Descriptive Books$() can be sacrificed. Linking books are not enough.

Hold the $(c)Target Book$() in your main hand and the $(c)Sacrificial Book$() in your offhand. While sneaking, use the target book. The sacrifice only works if the offhand Age is more stable than the target.

The target does not inherit the raw score difference directly. Mystcraft converts the stability gap into a percentage reduction, then removes that percentage from the target Age's current instability. Bigger stability gaps produce stronger purification.

A sacrificed Age becomes a dead world: void terrain, no sky bodies, no weather, no ordinary travel, no meaningful generation, and unreadable links. Players found there are expelled unless they are in creative or spectator.
